visual.general_description: A photograph of a small elongated pale pink-tan tissue fragment lying on a light blue wet surface beside a transparent ruler.
visual.detailed_description: A single colour photograph. An elongated, roughly sausage-shaped tissue fragment lies obliquely in the upper middle of the frame on a pale blue-grey surface dotted with water droplets. The left end is smooth and pale pink-tan; towards the right end the surface becomes irregular and lumpy with a more reddish-orange, rough area, and a few small dark brown spots lie on the smoother part. A transparent plastic ruler lies below the fragment, parallel to its long axis, with printed numerals 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 along its upper edge; the unit is not printed. The fragment extends over roughly the first three numbered graduations of the ruler as viewed, but the fragment and ruler are not in the same plane, so the length is only approximate. No panel letters, patient identifiers, text overlays, instruments or hands are visible.

visual.general_description: A pink and purple stained histology microphotograph of a densely cellular field of mostly small dark-blue nuclei in pale pink tissue.
visual.detailed_description: A single low-contrast, slightly blurred stained microscopy field filling the frame, with a pale pink background and very many cell nuclei. Most nuclei are small, round and dark blue-purple and are scattered fairly evenly across the field. Scattered among them are larger cells with paler pink cytoplasm and larger, paler nuclei, mainly in the upper right and central areas; some of the larger cells appear to have pink granular or foamy cytoplasm. There is a faint pink fibrillar or streaky area toward the left and lower left. A small pale turquoise-green fragment lies near the upper right centre and a few red-pink granular cells are seen in the left lower part. No scale bar, panel letter, text, arrow or other annotation is visible, and the resolution does not allow individual cells to be classified from the pixels.

visual.general_description: A pale tan immunostained tissue section with patchy light-brown staining and two black arrows pointing at brown-stained areas.
visual.detailed_description: A single low-magnification immunohistochemistry-style field with an overall pale tan to beige background and a very fine granular texture. Patchy light brown to orange-brown staining is scattered through the tissue, concentrated in two areas: the lower left, and the upper right of centre. Two thick black arrows point at these areas: one at the left edge pointing right toward the lower left stained region, and one at the upper right pointing left toward the upper right stained region. Several irregular white clefts or tears run through the lower and central part of the section, and a larger white gap lies along the top edge. No blue counterstain nuclei, scale bar, panel letter or text label is visible, and individual stained cells are not resolved.
